entities.summary: Hu Qing is a male amateur boxer from China. He competed at the 2006 Asian Games in the lightweight division winning the gold medal in the match against Mongolia's Uranchimegiin Mönkh-Erdene. Hu Qing was a athletes & competitors from Lu'an (b. 1986-01-19, Lu'an). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
